summary.zh: 把杂乱的想法和待办整理成项目与任务清单
summary.en: Sort a messy brain dump into projects, tasks and links

description.zh: 把一段没有结构的想法、任务和计划倒出来之后，按项目、任务和彼此关联分类，保留原话语气，不丢任何条目。适合脑子里事情太多、或收到一大段混乱记录需要理清的时候，不需要额外配置。
description.en: Sorts an unstructured dump of ideas, tasks and plans into projects, tasks and connections without dropping anything, keeping your own wording. Good when your head is full or you pasted a wall of notes.
